note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; rule texts are the author's illustrative text, not statements of any law. Both scenario statuses are supplied by the author; no outcome is inferred and neither scenario is presented as the right one.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Four long attributes and conditions, long titles, long scenario labels and captions, a long changed-fact text, several long shared facts and long comparison labels.

facts.title: Incident at the north gate of the community garden, Friday evening

attributes.text: A heavy wheelbarrow full of soil was left standing across the main gravel path
The wheelbarrow carries the painted number of the Plot 12 holder on its side
A neighbour says she saw it there at about 21:40, after sunset
No sign was placed next to it to warn other visitors

rules.title: Community garden rule 4 on shared paths — fictional wording only
conditions: An object of any kind is left standing on a path that all members share
by a person who holds a plot in the garden at the time
after the garden has been closed for the evening by the warden
without a warning sign placed next to the object

issues.text: At what time did the warden actually close the garden that Friday evening?

assumptions: The main gravel path counts as a shared path for everyone

scenarioA.label: Every attribute supplied as coinciding
scenarioA.caption: The neighbour's account of the time is supplied as matching the rule's timing condition

scenarioB.label: The time attribute supplied as disputed
scenarioB.caption: The neighbour's account of the time is supplied as disputed; nothing else is changed

params.changedFact: Attribute 3 “A neighbour says she saw it there at about 21:40”: coinciding in A, disputed in B
sharedFacts: the same fact card with the same title and wording

comparisonLabels.guide: This is the only row that differs between the two situations
comparisonLabels.neutral: Two situations supplied side by side for comparison — neither is marked as right and no conclusion is drawn
